review.reason: The change establishes an automated, bounded capability: an hourly scheduled recalculation workflow for eligible experiments. The implementation includes schedule definition, discovery rules, and basic parameter assertions in tests. This supports reliability and availability of experiment metrics but lacks broader systemic changes or demonstrated outcome quality.
review.posthog_relevance: Adds recurring maintenance and recovery path for saved metric calculations without requiring manual triggers, potentially reducing stale data exposure between user actions and warehouse ingestion.
review.uncertainty: No live execution or result verification visible; tier relies only on the presence and structure of scheduling code.
